conditions: include the copyright notice and MIT permission notice in copies or substantial portions of redistributed source snapshots
license.decision_basis: The exact pinned MIT license grants use, copy, modification, publication, distribution, sublicensing, and sale rights subject to notice retention. Under the project code-rights policy this is sufficient authority for the bounded training purpose and source redistribution subject to the MIT notice condition; public availability alone is not treated as authority.

upstream_ai_policy.basis: The policy governs responsibility and provenance for contributions submitted upstream; it does not revoke or narrow the MIT rights attached to the released source snapshot.

files.role: core class transformation and generated-method construction implementation
runtime attribute utility and serialization implementation

capacity_rule: Count only the four selected substantive human-authored Python implementation files after every hard gate passes. Re-export shims, typing stubs, docs, tests, benchmarks, examples, generated/build outputs, packaging metadata, lockfiles, and license text are excluded from code capacity.
explicit_exclusions: src/attrs/** forwarding and public re-export shims

evaluation_boundary.future_reservation_rule: Any exact path/blob identity reserved by a newer evaluation authority before final sealing is excluded and capacity is recomputed; evaluation use is never inferred from this training admission.

dedup.exact_identity: Git blob SHA-1 plus raw SHA-256 at execution
dedup.family_rule: python-attrs/attrs is one independent upstream source family; four files add byte capacity but one family credit

required_gates: canonical upstream repository is neither fork nor mirror
signed stable release tag resolves to the pinned commit
exact upstream commit and tree remain fetchable
license bytes match the pinned Git blob identity and MIT grant text
upstream AI policy is recorded and does not supersede the MIT release license
every selected file byte size and Git blob identity match
Python AST parse and compile succeed
privacy-like email and private-IP scan passes
generated/vendored/build/minified path and marker checks pass
no exact or >=0.85 near duplicate inside the selection or against incumbent admitted code objects
no selected path/blob is evaluation-reserved at the final live-registry check
